Container.Name: Cratekeep
Container.Overview: Cratekeep is a lightweight web interface for managing a beets music library. Review MusicBrainz matches, import music from an inbox, and edit metadata and file tags.[br][br]First run: select /data/inbox and /data/library in the setup screen. Configuration, databases, and the generated signing key persist in /data/config.[br][br]Inbox imports copy files into the Library and tag the copies, leaving originals in place. Use Refresh in Inbox to discover new audio files. All three folders must be writable by UID 99, GID 100 (Unraid nobody:users). Start with disposable copies.[br][br]Cratekeep has no built-in authentication. Use a trusted network or an authenticating reverse proxy; do not expose it directly to the internet.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: beets musicbrainz music library metadata tagging import

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Host port for the Cratekeep web interface.

Config.Name: AppData
Config.Description: Persistent configuration, SQLite databases, beets configuration, and generated signing key. Must be owned by, or writable to, UID 99, GID 100 (nobody:users).

Config.Name: Inbox
Config.Description: Choose your incoming music folder. Imports copy files and leave the originals here until you choose Remove imported. Must be writable and separate from the Library folder; neither may contain the other.

Config.Name: Library
Config.Description: Choose your destination music library. Cratekeep copies Inbox imports here and writes reviewed tags. Start with disposable copies. Must be writable and separate from Inbox.
